listing.title: My First Shapes & Colors Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Shape Pages – Circle, Square, Star, Heart & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly shapes and colors!

Little hands color 30 cute pages, from a red circle and a blue square to a yellow star and a pink heart. Each flat shape is named with a color, so children can color it in that color as they say the word. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • Shapes named with colors: Red Circle, Blue Square, Yellow Triangle, Green Rectangle, Orange Oval, Yellow Star, Pink Heart and Purple Diamond
  • More shapes: Blue Pentagon, Green Hexagon, Red Octagon, Yellow Crescent, Orange Half Circle, Purple Trapezoid, Pink Plus Sign and Orange Arrow
  • Solid shapes: Cube, Ball, Cone, Cylinder and Pyramid
  • Colorful things: Rainbow, Crayon, Paintbrush, Paint Palette, Paint Can, Traffic Light, Balloon, Kite and Umbrella
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
